resolution_criteria:
A by-election for the United Kingdom parliamentary constituency of Clacton is expected to be held soon following the announced resignation of incumbent Nigel Farage.

This market will resolve according to the candidate who wins the second-most valid votes in the Clacton parliamentary by-election.

The named candidates will be primarily ranked by the number of valid votes received in the specified election. If two or more candidates are tied on valid votes, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the candidates' listed names. This market will resolve to the candidate that occupies the second-highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

If the election results are not known definitively by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting. In case of ambiguity, this market will resolve solely based on official election results as published by Tendring District Council (https://www.tendringdc.gov.uk/) and the UK Parliament (https://www.parliament.uk/).

"Other" means any option not listed here.

# Clacton by-election, 2nd place: research briefing (as of 2026-07-31)

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-07-17: Tendring District Council published the official list of candidates. Polling day is Thursday 13 August 2026. There are a record 34 candidates, including Nigel Farage (Reform UK), Count Binface (Count Binface Party), Laurence Fox (Reclaim), William Clouston (SDP), John Stevens (Rejoin EU) and Adham Alkhatip (Forward Party), plus three Monster Raving Loony candidates and many independents. [Tendring DC](https://www.tendringdc.gov.uk/news/clacton-voters-to-choose-next-mp-as-by-election-candidates-confirmed)
- **Matthew Bensilum and Piers Corbyn are not on the official nomination list.** They cannot get any votes on this ballot.
- No result exists before the 2026-07-31 cutoff. Results will be declared by Tendring DC after the 13 August poll.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. Voting has not happened.
- The main parties are not standing: no Labour, Conservative, Lib Dem, Green or Restore Britain candidate. That leaves Count Binface as Farage's best-known opponent. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_Clacton_by-election), [LBC list](https://www.lbc.co.uk/article/candidates-clacton-by-election-full-list-5HjddQz_2/)
- Farage is standing again, so he is the overwhelming favourite to finish 1st. That makes him very unlikely to finish 2nd.
- One source says independent Abi Hookway withdrew because of alleged threats, but her name stays on the ballot. I could not confirm when this happened.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-07-16 to 07-24 (fieldwork): Survation polled 502 Clacton adults by phone for Mandate Research. Results: Farage 73%, Count Binface 20%, Laurence Fox 2%, all others 5%. In a Farage vs Binface head-to-head it was 69% to 31%. The Times reported that turnout could be very low. Write-ups of the poll appeared around 2026-08-03, after the cutoff, but the fieldwork was in July. [Mark Pack](https://www.markpack.org.uk/177246/first-clacton-by-election-opinion-poll-released/), [IBTimes](https://www.ibtimes.co.uk/count-binface-challenges-farage-clacton-election-1813861)
- 2026-07-17: Nominations closed with 34 candidates. [Tendring DC](https://www.tendringdc.gov.uk/news/clacton-voters-to-choose-next-mp-as-by-election-candidates-confirmed)
- 2026-07-11: A national Ipsos poll found 33% of Britons would prefer Binface to win and 21% Farage. This measures national opinion, not Clacton voting intention. [Ipsos](https://www.ipsos.com/en-uk/british-public-more-likely-prefer-count-binface-wins-clacton-election-nigel-farage)
- 2026-07-08: William Hill odds were Reform 1/6, Count Binface 7/2. The main parties said they would stand aside. [Freebets](https://www.freebets.com/news/clacton-by-election-odds-count-binface-odds-slashed-as-main-parties-stand-aside/)
- 2026-07-07: Farage resigned as MP to trigger the by-election. This came amid scrutiny of his personal finances and a donation story, and a standards inquiry. He says he has done nothing wrong and wants voters to decide. [Freebets](https://www.freebets.com/news/clacton-by-election-odds-count-binface-odds-slashed-as-main-parties-stand-aside/), [Mark Pack](https://www.markpack.org.uk/177246/first-clacton-by-election-opinion-poll-released/)

## 4. Base rates
- Main parties sometimes stand aside when an MP resigns to re-contest their own seat. Past examples include David Davis in Haltemprice and Howden (2008) and Zac Goldsmith in Richmond Park (2016). In those cases, minor or fringe candidates took the places behind the winner. In 2008 the Green Party came 2nd with about 7%.
- Farage held Clacton in 2024 with about 46%. In 2014 Douglas Carswell won the Clacton by-election for UKIP with about 60%. [2014 by-election](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2014_Clacton_by-election)
- The only constituency poll shows a 2nd-place gap of about 18 points between Binface (20%) and the next candidate, Fox (2%). A single-candidate by-election poll can be off by several points, but rarely by that much.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Polymarket runs a "Clacton by-election: 2nd place" market, created 2026-07-07. Aggregators gave Count Binface about 68 to 90% at various points in July: Robinhood around 68%, Lines around 70%, PredScope around 90% in early July. I could not get an exact price as of 2026-07-31. [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/clacton-by-election-2nd-place-20260707214539733), [Lines](https://www.lines.com/prediction-markets/politics/clacton-by-election-2nd-place-20260707214539733), [Robinhood](https://robinhood.com/us/en/prediction-markets/elections/clacton-by-election/)
- Kalshi has a similar 2nd-place market (KXCLACTON2ND). [Kalshi](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxclacton2nd/clacton-byelection-2nd-place/kxclacton2nd-clactonbyelection26sep01-2)
- Polymarket also has a market on Binface's vote share. Its most popular range was 10 to 20%. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/clacton-by-election-count-binface-vote-20260708142507718)
- Bookmaker odds for Binface to *win* lengthened during July, from 7/2 to roughly 8/1 and then 11/1 according to Oddspedia. That reflects his chances of winning, not of coming 2nd. [Oddspedia](https://oddspedia.com/insights/features/clacton-by-election-odds), [Racing Post](https://www.racingpost.com/sport/special-events/politics/clacton-by-election-betting-nigel-farage-count-binface-ak08j6n7sZGH/)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-08-13: polling day, with the count and declaration overnight into 2026-08-14 at Tendring DC.
- Things that could still change the order: Farage being disqualified or withdrawing (unlikely), very low turnout, a late surge for Laurence Fox or another minor candidate, or a late tactical consolidation of anti-Farage votes. On the evidence so far, that consolidation would mostly help Binface.
- Possible further constituency polls before polling day. I found none other than Survation.
